description: The chart is a grouped bar chart illustrating the measured “effect” of context masking perturbations across four linguistic tag categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories (case, gender, number, tense) under the axis label “tag,” arranged left to right in that order, and the vertical value axis is labeled “effect” on a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20 (the plotted range extends slightly below 0 and a bit above 20 to accommodate error bars). Each category shows six side-by-side bars corresponding to the legend in the upper right: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red), each with vertical error bars. For “case,” the bars are approximately ~6 (mBERT-L₂), ~5.5 (XLM-L₂), ~3 (mBERT-R₂), ~2 (XLM-R₂), ~12–13 (mBERT-B₂), and ~11 (XLM-B₂), with relatively large error bars on several series. For “gender,” the bars are roughly ~1.5 (mBERT-L₂), ~0.3 (XLM-L₂), ~2 (mBERT-R₂), ~1 (XLM-R₂), ~4–4.5 (mBERT-B₂), and ~3–3.5 (XLM-B₂), again with noticeable error bars. For “number,” the bars are about ~1.2 (mBERT-L₂), ~0.8 (XLM-L₂), ~1.0 (mBERT-R₂), ~0.6 (XLM-R₂), ~2.8–3.0 (mBERT-B₂), and ~2.3–2.5 (XLM-B₂), with moderate error bars. For “tense,” all bars are close to zero, approximately ~0.5 (mBERT-L₂), ~0.0 to slightly negative (XLM-L₂), ~0.0 to slightly negative (mBERT-R₂), ~0.0 to slightly negative (XLM-R₂), ~0.4–0.6 (mBERT-B₂), and ~0.5–0.7 (XLM-B₂), with smaller error bars than earlier categories. The bars are not sorted by height within categories, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent color coding and the presence of error bars.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations on various linguistic tags, categorized into case, gender, number, and tense. The horizontal axis represents the tag categories, labeled 'tag,' and includes case, gender, number, and tense. The vertical axis is labeled 'effect,' ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at intervals of 5 units. Each tag category features grouped bars representing different models or conditions, distinguished by specific colors corresponding to the legend: light blue for mBERT-L₂, dark blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, pink for mBERT-B₂, and red for XLM-B₂. In the 'case' category, mBERT-L₂ consistently exhibits the highest effect, with values exceeding 15, while XLM-B₂ shows the lowest effect, remaining below 5. The 'tense' category demonstrates a steady decline across all models, with values approaching zero. Error bars indicate the standard deviation, with the largest variability observed in the 'gender' category across all models.
